caption: Avg. accuracy across 11 datasets (y-axis) for each training method (x-axis)
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the average performance, measured in accuracy, across eleven datasets for four different training methods: Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune, ClinGS, and ClinGS (w/). The horizontal axis represents the training methods, displayed in alphabetical order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled "Average Performance," ranges from 0 to 60, utilizing a linear scale with tick intervals of 10. The bars correspond to each method and are colored blue, tan, green, and orange respectively. The bar for Standard attains a value of approximately 45, the Self-RAG bar reaches approximately 52, the FactTune bar is approximately 50, the ClinGS bar is approximately 53, and the ClinGS (w/) bar is approximately 55. All bars are equally spaced and there are no visually emphasized elements.
